Separate Swimming Controls
Version 1.0.0

Skyrim has no button for rising or sinking in water. This mod adds two, and a dive.

ASCEND AND DESCEND
Hold Ascend (right trigger, or T on the keyboard) to rise and Descend (left trigger, or Left Ctrl) to sink, at any camera angle.
Rising stops at the surface and sinking stops at the bottom. Sneak does not sneak in water, so you never climb out still
sneaking, and if you walk into water sneaking, that ends as you start to swim. Jump keeps its own key and is what leaves
the water: at the surface it does the game's own jump, and deeper down it does nothing, as in the unmodded game.
While you are in water, a button these rows hold does nothing else; on land it goes back to what it was.

DIVE
Press Dive (D-pad left, or Y on the keyboard) with deep water just ahead of you and you leap into it and go under. At the
surface it takes you straight under. Anywhere else the key keeps its game use.

Simple Diving System (Nexus 154534, optional, a separate download with its own requirements: Open Animation Replacer, and
Behavior Data Injector with Universal Plugin, or Nemesis or Pandora) gives the leap its dive pose in third person. Without
it the dive works and plays the game's own fall.

SETTINGS
Separate Swimming Controls in the Apocrypha Menu Framework: every key, both speeds, the dive. All of it is also in
SKSE\Plugins\SeparateSwimmingControls.ini, so the mod works the same without a menu framework.

WORKS BESIDE
Look-pitch swimming, and Underwater NG and sprint swimming mods: the movement is added to theirs. With Underwater NG, gear
that pulls you under keeps doing so: hold Ascend against it, or change its Base buoyancy or Armor affects swimming settings. It does not edit the
control map, so it does not fight a mod that does.

REQUIREMENTS
SKSE and Address Library. Skyrim 1.5.97, 1.6 or 1.7: the installer picks the build.
